verdict.rationale: Cekura is a hosted testing and observability SaaS. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The only GitHub evidence is the cekura-skills plugin repo for AI coding assistants. That repo is not the product's source, and no license is stated anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
